summary: Reserved burst credits not allocated to subaccount after plan downgrade during hourly billing window
description: Issue summary: Customer reports that reserved burst credits (hourly burst capacity) were not applied to their subaccount after they downgraded a seat-level Dedicated plan in the middle of an hourly billing window. Impact: BrightCart observed a sudden unexpected invoice adjustment and a missing credit line for the subaccount, resulting in an overage alert and a triggered automated payment hold. Timeline: 2026-03-01 22:05 UTC - Customer changed plan (downgrade) on parent org. 2026-03-01 22:12 UTC - Scheduler ran hourly credit allocation job for burst capacity. 2026-03-01 22:20 UTC - Customer subaccount shows no burst credits applied; parent account shows partial allocation. 2026-03-02 08:00 UTC - Customer opened support ticket. Key question: why weren't burst credits allocated to the subaccount when the allocation job ran within the same hour as the downgrade?
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Have parent org with Reserved Dedicated + hourly burst capacity enabled.
2) Create subaccount and assign some reserved capacity via console.
3) During an hourly billing window, downgrade seat-level plan on the parent org (reduce total reserved count).
4) Allow hourly burst credit allocator to run (scheduler job at minute xx:12).
5) Inspect allocation ledger: expected equal pro-rata burst credits to remain on subaccount but observed missing allocations.
logs: 2026-03-01T22:12:06Z billing-engine: wrote ledger lines to bucket hourly-burst-20260301-22
investigation_notes: Hypothesis 1: Race between the downgrade event write and the credit-allocation job read window. Event timestamps recorded but the allocator might have used cached reservation totals from a previous snapshot.
Hypothesis 2: Allocation logic treats downgrades within the same hour as effective for the parent but not when deriving subaccount delta, causing parent to absorb credits instead of redistributing.
Query run: select * from hourly_allocations where org='brightcart' and window='2026-03-01T22' returned parent delta +2, subaccount delta 0.

Found telemetry: reservation_change_event handled by /events/ledger consumer at 22:05 but reservation indexer had last refresh at 22:00; allocator reads reservation index at 22:11 which did not include indexer update -> potential stale view.
resolution: Workaround issued: Manual allocation correction performed for BrightCart subaccount and credit memo created to reverse overage. Engineering action: add atomic coupling between reservation indexer and hourly allocator to ensure refresh-before-allocate for events in prior 15 minutes. Short-term hotfix: modify allocator to re-fetch reservation deltas if allocation mismatches parent/subaccount sums. Billing team issued provisional credit memo ID CM-2026-0047 to customer. Pending code fix landing and follow-up audit of hourly windows.
